tasks.description: Create a data retention policy that deletes user activity data after 30 days. This policy should be enforced by an automated pipeline and apply to all user activity records without exception.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when 30 days have passed since collection, then the record is deleted from the event store.

tasks.description: Develop an automated job that deletes user activity data older than 30 days from the event store. The job should run periodically to ensure data retention policy is enforced.
acceptance_criteria: Given the automated deletion job, when it runs, then all user activity data older than 30 days is deleted from the event store.

tasks.description: Design and implement a data archiving solution that retains the complete historical event log for trend analysis. The solution should ensure that no activity events are deleted and the event log remains complete and queryable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the data archiving solution, when querying the event log, then all historical event data is available and queryable.

tasks.description: Implement access controls to restrict access to the event store and archived data to authorized personnel only. All access should be logged for auditing purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they attempt to access the event store or archived data, then access is granted only if they are authorized and all access is logged.

tasks.summary: Develop internal tools for querying event log
tasks.description: Create internal tools that allow authorized personnel to query the event log and archived data for trend analysis and other purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the internal tools, when a user queries the event log, then the tools return the expected results and allow for further analysis.

tasks.description: Develop a logging and auditing solution that tracks all access to the event store and archived data. The solution should provide a clear audit trail for compliance and security purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the auditing and logging solution, when a user accesses the event store or archived data, then all access is logged and a clear audit trail is provided.

tasks.summary: Conduct internal audit and compliance review
tasks.description: Perform an internal audit and compliance review to ensure that the data retention policy is enforced consistently and stakeholders' needs are met.
acceptance_criteria: Given the internal audit and compliance review, when the review is complete, then the system is found to be compliant with all relevant regulations and stakeholders' needs are met.
